Every piece is handmade to order. Orders placed through October 31 (Halloween rush): 10–15 business days to make. Orders placed after October 31: 5–7 business days to make. This product is not intended for use during sleep or unattended times and should not be used as a substitute for safe sleep practices. Keep away from heat sources and open flames.
